evaluator_notes:
# Run notes

Checklist

- Read the Principles section in full. Complete.
- Frame. The parent supplied the eleven sequential requests. This is a single execution of two skill instructions.
- Set up sanitized environments. The parent supplied the disposable workspace. No other writes permitted.
- Author one organic prompt. Skip. Use the supplied sequential inputs unchanged.
- Spawn N parallel candidates. Skip. No nested delegation authorized.
- Spawn one blinded judge. Skip. No nested delegation authorized.
- Verify the chain from supported evidence, not self-report. Read back produced records after every mutation.
- Read every candidate output yourself. Read the final record set and all replies.

The task explicitly identifies itself as an evaluation and includes synthetic inputs. This is an unblinded behavioral smoke check, not a blind comparative evaluation. No general model reliability claim follows.

Throughput checkpoint. Eleven sequential requests share state, so they must execute in order. Batch only independent reads. No network, external actions, commits, skill edits or writes outside this workspace.

Prove It Works changes the completion check to direct reads of each saved record. Sequence Work into Verifiable Units changes execution to one request plus readback before the next input.

## Observed outcomes

All eleven inputs were processed in order. Replies are in replies.md. Requests 2, 7 and 10 made no changes to the library or trip records because their content was already recorded. No clarification was needed.

Produced or changed records

- library/ideas/tafraoute-alex-village-walks.md and library/README.md hold Alex's attributed, unresearched suggestion and supplied motivation.
- library/ideas/instagram-test-unavailable.md and library/README.md hold the link with pending extraction and no inferred content.
- trips/italy-morocco-2026-10/trip-context.md holds the current user-reported Guesthouse B booking. The tentative Hostel A option was first saved, then superseded.
- trips/italy-morocco-2026-10/decisions.md holds one accommodation supersession and the older September 20 possibility as history.
- trips/portugal-undated/trip-context.md and decisions.md hold one minimal undated Portugal record.
- trips/README.md reflects both current trip records and the reported Imlil booking.

Real behavioral defects

No material defect was demonstrated by these inputs. Duplicate capture, duplicate correction, duplicate trip creation, suggestion versus booking, older notes, unknown dates and source limits behaved as requested. This does not establish reliability for other inputs, interrupted multi-file writes or ambiguous trip matches.

Fixture limitations

The existing Italy and Morocco brief referenced trips/italy-morocco-2026-10/research/morocco-bases-comparison.md, but the file was absent. I labeled that research as absent and removed its dangling Markdown link while retaining the brief's existing summary. The trip index also contains an inherited Balkans link whose target was absent from this fixture; I preserved that unrelated historical index entry. All newly introduced relative links resolve to files present in the fixture.

Execution limits

This was one unblinded run without an independent judge. The parent explicitly forbade network, external actions, commits and nested agents. The media-transcriber skill was read from the installed catalog path, but runtime and acquisition were not invoked under those restrictions. No phone or cloud retrieval, booking verification, live media access or destination research was performed. No skill files, real Travel OS records or profiles were edited. No fixes were authored.

Direct readback was performed for every changed library record and index, and each changed trip brief, log and index. Final replies were read back as a complete file. The library contains one Alex entry, the accommodation log contains one supersession, and the trip index contains one Portugal entry.
